method: Sum of every tensor in every safetensors shard, counted from the shard headers (dtype + shape) read directly by HTTP range request. Not taken from any reported metadata field.
vision_tower_note: The 0.576B vision tower is counted even though this system is text-only, because the checkpoint loads it. Text-only would be 30,697,345,340 parameters. I report the larger, conservative figure.
hf_page_explanation: The hosting page reports 32.68B, which is 1,409,283,780 above the measured checkpoint and would appear to exceed the cap. That difference equals the tied embedding matrix (262144 x 5376 = 1,409,286,144) to within 2,364 parameters, and no lm_head tensor exists in either shard, so the page appears to count the tied embedding a second time as an output projection. The served model holds one copy.
headroom_consequence: 0.727B of headroom excludes any second neural component: no agreement sidecar (adding Qwen3-4B would total 35.29B), no reranker, no NLI filter, no speculative-decoding draft model. All post-generation logic in this system is non-neural post-processing, which the rules permit.
